templates.name: Minecraft: Java Edition
templates.description: Official Mojang vanilla Java server. Downloads the exact release you choose straight from Mojang's version manifest.

options.label: Minecraft version
options.help: Use "latest" or a release such as 1.21.4 (see the Minecraft version manifest).

options.label: Accept the Minecraft EULA
options.help: Required by Mojang before the server will start: https://www.minecraft.net/eula

options.label: Server MOTD
options.help: Shown in the multiplayer server list.

templates.notes: Requires Java 21 or newer. The first start generates the world and can take a minute.

templates.name: Minecraft: Paper
templates.description: High-performance Paper server with plugin support. Resolves the newest build for the selected version from the PaperMC API.

options.label: Minecraft version
options.help: Use "latest" or a Paper version such as 1.21.4.

options.label: Accept the Minecraft EULA
options.help: Required by Mojang before the server will start.

templates.notes: Plugins go into the plugins folder. Paper is a drop-in replacement for vanilla.

templates.name: Minecraft: Bedrock
templates.description: Official Bedrock Dedicated Server for Windows and Linux, fetched from Microsoft's download service.

options.label: Xbox Live authentication
options.help: Disable only for private LAN testing.

templates.notes: Bedrock uses UDP. Open UDP {{port}} in Windows Firewall for internet play.

templates.name: FiveM (FXServer)
templates.description: FiveM/GTA V roleplay server using the latest recommended FXServer Windows artifact.

options.label: Cfx.re license key
options.help: Create a key at https://keymaster.fivem.net and paste it here.

files.content:
# Generated by WinPanel
endpoint_add_tcp "0.0.0.0:{{port}}"
endpoint_add_udp "0.0.0.0:{{port}}"
sv_hostname "{{serverName}}"
sv_licenseKey "{{licenseKey}}"
sv_maxclients 32
sv_endpointprivacy true
onesync on
ensure mapmanager
ensure chat
ensure spawnmanager
ensure sessionmanager
ensure basic-gamemode
ensure hardcap
ensure rconlog

templates.notes: A FiveM server needs the rockstar-license key above. Resources belong in the resources folder; add ensure lines to server.cfg.

options.help: Upload the jar with the file manager after creating the server.

templates.name: Node.js application
templates.description: Run a Node.js project with a generated package.json and starter entrypoint.
templates.notes: Install dependencies with npm from the console once uploaded, then restart the server.

templates.name: Python application
templates.description: Run a Python 3 project with a starter entrypoint and virtualenv-friendly startup.

files.content:
# Generated by WinPanel. Replace with your application.
import os
from http.server import BaseHTTPRequestHandler, HTTPServer

PORT = int(os.environ.get("SERVER_PORT", "{{port}}"))


class Handler(BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
    def do_GET(self):
        body = b"Hello from WinPanel\n"
        self.send_response(200)
        self.send_header("Content-Type", "text/plain")
        self.send_header("Content-Length", str(len(body)))
        self.end_headers()
        self.wfile.write(body)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    print(f"Listening on http://localhost:{PORT}", flush=True)
    HTTPServer(("0.0.0.0", PORT), Handler).serve_forever()

templates.notes: Create a virtual environment from the console if you need isolated packages.

templates.name: Custom executable
templates.description: Bring your own Windows executable. WinPanel manages the process, console, files, ports, backups and monitoring.

options.label: Executable filename
options.help: Upload the executable and its files, then set the startup command.

templates.notes: Set the startup executable to a file you upload, for example server.exe, or to a command available on PATH.
